system.description:
Unpredictable Tonic: roll your Luck Pool. More Luck than Strange symbols: heal 4 wounds. More Strange than Luck: take 2 Blunt damage and gain Poisoned (1). A tie does nothing.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.159
system.summary: Unpredictable Tonic: roll your Luck Pool. More Luck than Strange symbols: heal 4 wounds. More Strange than Luck: take 2 Blunt damage and gain Poisoned (1). A tie does nothing.

automation.label: Unpredictable Tonic
automation.onSuccess: More Luck than Strange symbols: heal 4 wounds.
automation.onFail: More Strange than Luck symbols: take 2 Blunt damage and gain Poisoned (1).

automation.note: The result depends on Luck vs Strange symbols, not a CR, so the Director sets the CR after the roll. Count Talent symbols as Luck. More Luck: set CR 1 (heals 4). More Strange: set CR 5 (2 Blunt damage and Poisoned (1)). A tie: leave the CR unset and nothing happens. CR 5 also counts as a failed check, so the engine ticks the Doom Clock 1 minute per Strange symbol. The tonic doesn't call for that, so turn the clock back.
